## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change and why? Link the motivation, not just the diff. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new functionality
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `refactor`: code change without behaviour change
- [ ] `perf`: performance improvement
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore`: tooling, dependencies or CI
- [ ] **Breaking change** (`!` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`)

## Related issues

<!-- e.g. Closes #123 -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `uv run pytest` passes
- [ ] `uv run pre-commit run --all-files` passes (ruff, mypy, file hygiene)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs updated if needed
- [ ] Breaking changes are documented in the commit message and changelog
